columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Group identifier that is populated automatically for Oracle Cloud customers. Otherwise, use a positive integer.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the intercompany batch. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DATE_PROCESSED
columns.description: Date processed.  Oracle internal use only.  Populated by the Import Intercompany Transactions process.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is increased every time the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
